defs.def: a doctor who is trained to perform surgery (= medical operations that involve cutting open a person's body) 外科医生

ex.s: When he was waking up after the surgeon had finished, he whispered, "Don't you were so many of them.
ex.t: 当外科医生做完手术、他苏醒时，他低声说道：“你别……你有这么多。”

ex.s: Look at the pictures below and discuss the following questions in pairs A surgeon performs operations.
ex.t: 看下面的图片，两人一组讨论以下问题 外科医生实施手术。

ex.s: FRANK: Surgeons are already using robotic technology with VR to perform complex surgery.
ex.t: 弗兰克：外科医生已经在用机器人技术和虚拟现实来进行复杂的手术。

ex.s: This technology can be applied to train new surgeons; it also enables experts to test new techniques safely before trying them on human subjects.
ex.t: 这项技术可用于培训新外科医生；它还能让专家在对人体试验之前，先安全地测试新技术。

ex.s: He lost a lot of blood on the way to the hospital, but thanks to blood donation, the surgeon managed to save him.
ex.t: 他在去医院的路上失血过多，但多亏了献血，外科医生才把他救了回来。
